title: Life is easy. Why do we make it so hard? | Jon Jandai | TEDxDoiSuthep
summary: Thai farmer Jon Jandai talks about leaving Bangkok to farm and build his own house, arguing that food, shelter, clothing and medicine are easy to provide and that modern life is made needlessly complicated. He founded the Pun Pun Center for Self-reliance.
why: HN recommends it as a thoughtful counterpoint to the pursuit of complicated, consumption-driven lives.

quote.text: He self-reports being much much happier, whether you believe it or not.
